"""Main retires closed duplicates and publishes compact consumer evidence."""
import fcntl
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
from pathlib import Path
import time

B = Path('/home/yayoi/.local/state/strata-sycl/post-reboot-tuning-20261007')
D = Path('/home/yayoi/ghq/github.com/yqYo1/Strata/.worktree/docs-sycl-storage-retention-20261009')
F = D / 'bench/results/2026-10-12-latest-updates-pristine-builds-host-regression'
W = D.parent / 'sync-xe-v0143-nonfinite-20261012'
R = B / 'research-20261009'
L = Path('/home/yayoi/ghq/github.com/MistVVK/XeStrata/.worktree/fix-xestrata-e32-host-handoff-20261011/.lint')
O = B / 'xe-llvm-v711-source-v5/direct_owner.py'
assert hashlib.sha256(O.read_bytes()).hexdigest() == 'a29d8257eecc77c4ad9ae6671d092b56f4c09a35c4247c125fed3a8c8bc1f95f'
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('closed_update_owner', O)
m = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(m)
ENV = dict(PATH=str(L / 'venv/bin') + ':' + str(L / 'bin') + ':/usr/bin:/bin', HOME='/home/yayoi', LANG='C.UTF-8', LC_ALL='C.UTF-8')


def identity(p):
    return dict(path=str(p), sha256=m.sha(p), bytes=p.stat().st_size)


with (B / 'owned-v0141-measurement.lock').open('a') as lock:
    fcntl.flock(lock, fcntl.LOCK_EX | fcntl.LOCK_NB)
    out = B / 'latest-update-main-closed-boundary-root-v161-v2'
    assert not out.exists()
    out.mkdir()
    r = dict(active=True, complete=False, passed=False, commands=[], source=identity(Path(__file__)),
             gpu_executed=False, artifacts=[])
    def save():
        (out / 'record.json').write_text(json.dumps(r, indent=2) + '\n')
    owner = m.Owner(out / 'commands', save)
    r['commands'] = owner.commands
    start = time.monotonic()
    prepared = []
    previous_p = B / 'latest-update-main-closed-boundary-root-v161/record.json'
    previous = json.loads(previous_p.read_text())
    assert not previous['active'] and not previous['complete'] and not previous['passed']
    assert previous['error'] == 'AssertionError()'
    assert len(previous['artifacts']) == 2
    allowed = {x['path']: x for x in previous['artifacts']}
    for name, pin in allowed.items():
        assert identity(Path(name)) == pin
    assert not (B / 'latest-update-main-closed-boundary-retention-v161.json').exists()
    def run(label, argv, cwd=D):
        left = 600 - (time.monotonic() - start)
        assert left > 0
        c, so, se = owner.run(label, argv, ENV, cwd, wall=min(120, left), cpu=480,
            rss_cap=8 << 30, text_cap=64 << 20, file_cap=64 << 20, total_cap=96 << 20)
        r.setdefault('evidence', {})[label] = dict(stdout=so.read_text(), stderr=se.read_text())
        save()
        assert m.closed(c) and c['exit_code'] == 0 and c['session_anchored']
        return so.read_text().strip()
    def write(relative, value):
        p = F / relative
        raw = json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n'
        assert len(raw.encode()) < 1 << 20
        if p.exists():
            assert str(p) in allowed and identity(p) == allowed[str(p)]
            assert p.read_bytes() == raw.encode()
        else:
            p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            p.write_text(raw)
        prepared.append(p)
        r['artifacts'].append(identity(p))
    try:
        status = run('status-before', ['/usr/bin/git', 'status', '--porcelain', '--untracked-files=all'])
        assert sorted(status.splitlines()) == sorted('?? ' + str(Path(name).relative_to(D)) for name in allowed)
        write('retention-planner-failure-v161.json', dict(original=identity(previous_p),
            receipt=previous, source=identity(B / 'latest-update-main-closed-boundary-v161.py'),
            source_content=(B / 'latest-update-main-closed-boundary-v161.py').read_text(),
            original_status_preserved=True, cleanup_started=False,
            reason='Planner asserted natural expected diagnostic failure, but the original diagnostic hit its bounded log cap. No deletion manifest was created and no raw files were deleted. The original failed status remains unchanged.'))
        assert run('branch', ['/usr/bin/git', 'branch', '--show-current']) == 'docs/sycl-storage-retention-2026-10-09'
        assert run('origin', ['/usr/bin/git', 'remote', 'get-url', 'origin']) == 'git@github.com:yqYo1/Strata.git'
        assert all(line.startswith('file:/home/yayoi/.config/git/config') for line in
            run('identity', ['/usr/bin/git', 'config', '--show-origin', '--get-regexp', r'^user\.(name|email)$']).splitlines())
        assert run('head-before', ['/usr/bin/git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD']) == 'ad89123365d876641bdb708ef1408a5dee161b4b'
        publisher_p = B / 'latest-update-main-updates-final-boundary-root-v3/record.json'
        publisher = json.loads(publisher_p.read_text())
        assert publisher['passed'] and publisher['complete'] and not publisher['active']
        assert publisher['revision'] == 'ad89123365d876641bdb708ef1408a5dee161b4b'
        assert all(m.closed(c) and c['exit_code'] == 0 for c in publisher['commands'])
        write('publisher-v160-success-v161.json', dict(original=identity(publisher_p), original_status_preserved=True, receipt=publisher))
        entries, records = [], {str(publisher_p): m.sha(publisher_p)}
        model_root = B / 'latest-update-pristine-official-cache512-model-root-v1'
        for phase, version in (('official-startup', 'v159'), ('official-model', 'v160')):
            p = model_root / phase / 'record.json'
            v = json.loads(p.read_text())
            assert v['passed'] and v['complete'] and not v['active'] and v['model_normal_close'] and v['kernel_gate_passed']
            archive = F / ('receipts-' + version) / (str(p.relative_to(B)).replace('/', '--') + ('.json' if version == 'v159' else ''))
            if not archive.exists() and version == 'v159':
                archive = F / 'receipts-v159/latest-update-pristine-official-cache512-model-root-v1--official-startup.json'
            assert json.loads(archive.read_text())['original']['sha256'] == m.sha(p)
            records[str(p)] = m.sha(p)
            stderr = p.parent / 'commands/engine.stderr'
            if phase == 'official-model':
                lines = [line for line in stderr.read_text().splitlines() if any(word in line for word in
                    ('ranked pairs', 'per-layer slots', 'pre-filled', 'pool workers', 'decode expert cache',
                     'KV streaming:', 'tokens (windows)', 'tokens (windows) in', 'tokens ='))]
                write('official-cache512-model-stderr-excerpt-v161.json', dict(original=identity(stderr),
                    selected_lines=lines, scope='Actual startup/quota/fill/workers and phase diagnostics; no bandwidth ceiling or quality proof'))
            for c in v['commands'] + v['guard_commands']:
                assert m.closed(c) and c['exit_code'] == 0 and c['session_anchored']
                for name, pin in c['logs'].items():
                    raw = p.parent / 'commands' / name
                    item = identity(raw)
                    assert item['sha256'] == pin['sha256'] and item['bytes'] == pin['bytes']
                    entries.append(dict(**item, replacement=str(archive),
                        reason='Closed success; exact protocol/provider/fault/close evidence extracted and committed; no remaining raw trace consumer'))
            if v.get('input'):
                parent = Path(v['input']['parent_path'])
                assert m.sha(parent) == v['input']['parent_sha256']
                raw = p.parent / 'tokens.txt'
                assert m.sha(raw) == v['input']['sha256']
                entries.append(dict(**identity(raw), replacement=str(archive),
                    reason='Closed derived token input; canonical parent and derivation/hash remain'))
        for folder in ('latest-update-main-cache-startup-retention-boundary-root-v1',
                       'latest-update-main-updates-final-boundary-root-v1',
                       'latest-update-main-updates-final-boundary-root-v2',
                       'latest-update-main-updates-final-boundary-root-v3'):
            p = B / folder / 'record.json'
            v = json.loads(p.read_text())
            assert not v['active'] and all(m.closed(c) for c in v['commands'])
            records[str(p)] = m.sha(p)
            for raw in sorted((p.parent / 'staged').rglob('*')):
                if not raw.is_file():
                    continue
                target = F / raw.relative_to(p.parent / 'staged')
                equal = target.is_file() and m.sha(target) == m.sha(raw)
                if not target.exists():
                    target = F / 'publisher-lint-environment-failure-v160.json'
                assert target.is_file()
                entries.append(dict(**identity(raw), replacement=str(target), replacement_byte_identical=equal,
                    reason='Byte-identical committed duplicate' if equal else
                    'Superseded unpublished candidate; failed status/source/hash history and final corrected report preserved'))
        diag_p = B / 'latest-update-main-publisher-license-diagnosis-root-v1/record.json'
        diag = json.loads(diag_p.read_text())
        assert not diag['active'] and not diag['complete'] and not diag['passed']
        assert not diag['expected_diagnostic_failure'] and len(diag['commands']) == 1
        c = diag['commands'][0]
        assert c['error'] == "RuntimeError('combined log cap')"
        assert c['exit_code'] == -15 and not c['observation_complete']
        assert c['direct_child_reaped'] and c['session_empty'] and c['session_anchored']
        assert c['ownership_status'] == 'observed' and not c['survivors'] and not c['errors']
        assert c['cleanup'] and all(x['signal'] == 'SIGTERM' and x['result'] == 'sent' for x in c['cleanup'])
        records[str(diag_p)] = m.sha(diag_p)
        for raw in sorted((diag_p.parent / 'commands').glob('*.stdout')):
            entries.append(dict(**identity(raw),
                replacement=str(F / 'publication-diagnostics-v160/latest-update-main-publisher-license-diagnosis-root-v1--record.json'),
                reason='Bounded verbose historical-license diagnostic hit its log cap and was terminated/reaped by its owner. Original FAILED/incomplete status, error, excerpt and hash remain committed; the full partial listing has no remaining consumer'))
        assert len({entry['path'] for entry in entries}) == len(entries)
        manifest = dict(passed=False, active=True, owner='/root', entries=entries, deleted=[],
            original_statuses_preserved=True, immutable_receipts=records,
            reclaimed_logical_bytes=sum(e['bytes'] for e in entries),
            allocated_blocks_before=sum(Path(e['path']).stat().st_blocks * 512 for e in entries),
            retained_consumers=['Exact CAPS stdout/binary/source/record for current resolver',
                'Canonical64K input and whole37462 held-out input', 'All original individual scalar measurement and failed receipt statuses',
                'Source-only histogram/raw-sample packets for Main future qualification'])
        manifest_p = B / 'latest-update-main-closed-boundary-retention-v161.json'
        assert not manifest_p.exists()
        def save_manifest():
            manifest_p.write_text(json.dumps(manifest, indent=2) + '\n')
        save_manifest()
        for entry in entries:
            raw = Path(entry['path'])
            assert m.sha(raw) == entry['sha256'] and Path(entry['replacement']).is_file()
            raw.unlink()
            manifest['deleted'].append(entry['path'])
            save_manifest()
        assert all(m.sha(Path(p)) == digest for p, digest in records.items())
        manifest.update(active=False, passed=True)
        save_manifest()
        write('closed-update-deletion-manifest-v161.json', manifest)
        reports = []
        for number in (259, 260, 261, 262):
            found = list(R.glob('*round' + str(number) + '-v1.txt'))
            assert len(found) == 1
            p = found[0]
            relative = 'research/' + p.name
            write(relative + '.json', dict(original=identity(p), content=p.read_text(),
                model='gpt-6-luna', main_full_report_review=True, measured=False))
            reports.append(dict(original=identity(p), archive=relative + '.json', status='completed',
                main_full_report_review=True, model='gpt-6-luna', measured=False))
        p = R / 'implementation-prefill-cpu-job-histogram-fixture-source-v1.txt'
        assert m.sha(p) == 'ec3bd967e5833e6e31ae2064193b0f0dd7209d2287e196fea57d3f31f0c9b2d8'
        relative = 'research/' + p.name + '.json'
        write(relative, dict(original=identity(p), content=p.read_text(), model='gpt-6.1-sol',
            status='SourceOnlyUnverified', main_full_report_review=True, measured=False, executed=False))
        reports.append(dict(original=identity(p), archive=relative, status='SourceOnlyUnverified',
            main_full_report_review=True, model='gpt-6.1-sol', measured=False, executed=False))
        packet = B / 'implementation-prefill-cpu-job-histogram-fixture-source-v1'
        for name in ('manifest.json', 'changes.patch', 'SOURCE_CONTRACT.txt', 'MAIN_TEST_PLAN.txt'):
            p = packet / name
            write('source-packets-v161/implementation-prefill-cpu-job-histogram-fixture-source-v1--' + name + '.json',
                dict(original=identity(p), content=p.read_text(), status='SourceOnlyUnverified',
                     applied=False, executed=False, main_test_owner=True))
        prior = F / 'report-registry-v160.json'
        assert json.loads(prior.read_text())['research_completed'] == 761
        write('report-registry-v161.json', dict(research_completed=766, prior_registry_path=str(prior.relative_to(D)),
            prior_registry_sha256=m.sha(prior), new_reports=reports, main_sole_execution_owner=True,
            recurring_research_completed=['R259 closed raw-log consumers', 'R260 actual compiled official auto/worker safety gates',
                'R261 effective integrated Dm writer route', 'R262 native free grouped GEMM event timing contract'],
            implementation_returned='6.1-sol source-only actual CPU dispatch histogram fixture; unapplied/unexecuted; all tests/builds remain Main-owned',
            corrections=['R245 proposes expert-cache auto, not prefill auto. R260 keeps these distinct and audits actual compiled sycl source.',
                         'Pristine official cache screens are not best-tuned qualification. Native host/shared-atomic false excludes large batched PLE/Stager marker polls; source has no automatic safe-window fallback.',
                         'R259 raw-log consumer audit is static. Main separately verified closed/pushed source/result artifacts and exact file hashes under exclusive lock before cleanup.',
                         'R261 leaves grouped oneMKL routing conditional. R262 confirms this free build compiles STRATA_ONEMATH=0 and f16_groups returns false. Exact fallback GPU backend remains unmeasured.',
                         'R262 describes a future profiling-enabled queue/event contract. No production queue change, profiler run or kernel performance claim was made.',
                         'The first retention planner stopped before deletion because the license diagnostic had been bounded/terminated rather than a natural expected failure. Its failed/incomplete state is preserved; retry verifies physical ownership and quiescence only.']))
        write('closed-boundary-controller-v161.json', dict(original=identity(Path(__file__)), content=Path(__file__).read_text()))
        run('report-lints', ['/bin/bash', str(W / 'tools/lint/run.sh'), *map(str, prepared)], cwd=W)
        run('secret-scan', [str(L / 'bin/gitleaks'), 'dir', str(F), '--no-banner', '--redact'])
        run('stage', ['/usr/bin/git', 'add', '--', *[str(p.relative_to(D)) for p in prepared]])
        run('check', ['/usr/bin/git', 'diff', '--cached', '--check'])
        run('commit', ['/usr/bin/git', 'commit', '-m', 'docs(sycl): retain compact update evidence and retire closed duplicates'])
        r['revision'] = run('head', ['/usr/bin/git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'])
        run('push', ['/usr/bin/git', 'push', 'origin', 'HEAD'])
        assert not run('status-after', ['/usr/bin/git', 'status', '--porcelain'])
        r['complete'] = True
    except BaseException as error:
        import traceback
        r['error'] = repr(error)
        r['traceback'] = traceback.format_exc()
    finally:
        r.update(active=owner.active is not None, finished_utc=m.utc())
        r['passed'] = bool(r['complete'] and not r['active'] and not r.get('error'))
        save()
    print(json.dumps({k: r.get(k) for k in ('passed', 'error', 'revision')}))
    raise SystemExit(0 if r['passed'] else 1)
